topic: Local Language Models for Reliable AI Agents
research_question: How can local language models be used to build reliable AI agents?

steps.purpose: Identify existing research on local language models and their applications in AI, including strengths and limitations.
Design and develop experiments to evaluate the performance of local language models in building reliable AI agents, considering factors such as data quality, model complexity, and evaluation metrics.
Develop and train local language models using a variety of datasets and evaluation metrics, and analyze the results to identify the most effective approaches for building reliable AI agents.

Develop case studies of successful applications of local language models in building reliable AI agents, including examples of industries, domains, or use cases where these models have been successfully deployed.
